description: This Java class defines a REST controller named UserController for managing user-related operations in an admin context. It provides endpoints to list users, update user roles, and delete users, restricted to users with the ADMIN role.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: REST controller for user management, accessible only by admins. Includes endpoints for listing users, updating user roles, and deleting users.

methods.name: UserController
methods.description: Constructor injecting UserService into the controller.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all registered users.

methods.name: updateRoles
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update a user's roles based on provided role change request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a user by ID.
